title: Annual Rate Review Terms — Independent Living Residency Agreement Schedule
content:
The Independent Living Residency Agreement fixes four rate review terms for every apartment type. They are the same for all six apartment types.

| Apartment type | Minimum written notice before an increase takes effect | Contractual ceiling on a single annual increase | New-resident rate guarantee | Month of the normal annual effective date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Studio | 60 calendar days | 7.5% | 12 calendar months | month 1 (January) |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom | 60 | 7.5% | 12 | 1 |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom Deluxe | 60 | 7.5% | 12 | 1 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom | 60 | 7.5% | 12 | 1 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe | 60 | 7.5% | 12 | 1 |
| Independent Living Cottage Home | 60 | 7.5% | 12 | 1 |

## What each term means

- **Minimum written notice** — the minimum number of calendar days of written notice before a monthly service fee increase takes effect.
- **Contractual ceiling** — the ceiling on any single annual increase of the monthly service fee, as a percentage of the fee in effect immediately before the increase. Under this agreement it is 7.5 percent.
- **New-resident rate guarantee** — the number of calendar months after the move-in date during which the monthly service fee may not be increased.
- **Normal annual effective month** — the calendar month (1 to 12) on whose first day the annual increase normally takes effect; month 1 is January, so the normal effective date is January 1.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A monthly service fee of 4,000.00 raised by the full contractual ceiling of 7.5 percent would become 4,300.00. A resident whose move-in date was in March of one year is still inside a 12-month guarantee on January 1 of the following year.
